description: This script configures Quality of Service (QoS) rules and firewall settings on a network device, likely running OpenWrt. It manages kernel modules, network interfaces, and iptables rules for traffic shaping and classification.

methods.name: add_insmod
methods.description: Adds a kernel module using insmod or modprobe, with reference counting.

methods.name: find_ifname
methods.description: Finds network interface name for a given interface, varies if on OpenWrt or not.

methods.name: parse_matching_rule
methods.description: Constructs iptables rules based on matching criteria and options.

methods.name: config_cb
methods.description: Handles configuration options for interfaces and classification rules.

methods.name: qos_parse_config
methods.description: Parses QoS configuration entries and sets up interfaces and rules.

methods.name: enum_classes
methods.description: Enumerates and assigns class numbers to QoS classes.

methods.name: cls_var
methods.description: Sets class variables like packet size, delay, rate, etc., from config.

methods.name: tcrules
methods.description: Generates traffic control rules using awk script.

methods.name: start_interface
methods.description: Initializes and starts QoS on a specific network interface.

methods.name: start_interfaces
methods.description: Starts QoS on all configured interfaces.

methods.name: add_rules
methods.description: Adds iptables rules for a QoS class group.

methods.name: start_cg
methods.description: Starts a QoS class group, setting up iptables and traffic control.

methods.name: start_firewall
methods.description: Initializes firewall rules and modules for QoS.

methods.name: stop_firewall
methods.description: Removes QoS-related iptables rules and chains.
